note: [L] gets J = 0 and the colour coefficient in StressFlux.bilinear_real and VerifiedReset.label_color, but argues differently: a cyclic identity gives A([x,y],z) = 0 and commutators span. It does not use the self-/skew-adjointness of ad(JX) or the centrality of JX.

snippet.text:
lemma bilinear_real (H : G.Simple) (B : G.Color →ₗ[ℝ] G.Color →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ x y z, B (G.ad x y) z = - B y (G.ad x z)) : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x y, B x y = c * ⟪x,y⟫_ℝ := by
  let A := B - B.flip
  have hS (x y : G.Color) : A x y = - A y x := by dsimp [A]; ring
  have hI (x y z : G.Color) : A (G.ad x y) z = A (G.ad x z) y := by dsimp [A]; rw [hi,hi x z]; ring
  have hW (x y z : G.Color) : A (G.ad x y) z = - A (G.ad y x) z := by nth_rw 1 [ad_antisym]; simp
  have he (x y z : G.Color) : A (G.ad x y) z = 0 := by linarith [hI x y z,hW x z y,hI z x y,hW z y x,hI y z x,hW y x z]
  apply invariant_scalar H B (fun x y => sub_eq_zero.mp ?_) hi
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (linear_zero H (A.flip y) (fun _ _ => he _ _ _)) x

proof_context.conclusion: An ad-invariant real bilinear form on a simple Lie algebra is a scalar multiple of the inner product; its antisymmetric part vanishes because A(ad x y, z) = 0 by a cyclic identity and commutators span (linear_zero).

lemma label_color {f : Pot G n} (o : Site n) (hG : G.Simple) (hf : p.Regular X f) (b c : PlaqAxes) (x y : G.Color) :
    logHessian f ((wedge b x).field o) ((wedge c y).field o) = coeff f o b c * inner ℝ x y := by
  let M := labelForm f o b c
  have h (g : G.El) (x y : G.Color) : M (G.adjoint g x) (G.adjoint g y) = M x y := by
    change logHessian f _ _ = _; rw [wedge_adj,wedge_adj,hessian_color hG hf]; rfl
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := bilinear_real hG M (bilinear_infinitesimal M h)
  change M x y = M (spike G) (spike G) * _; simp_rw [ht,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,spike_norm hG]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: Applying bilinear_real to the colour form of the Hessian gives its coefficient, read off at the unit test vector spike G.
